verdict.rationale: Bento exposes a broad programmatic surface. Documented APIs cover subscriber import, search, and update, event tracking, broadcast creation and scheduling, transactional email, Chat triage, and data deletion. A CLI claims 50+ commands for 'managing your entire Bento account', including templates and sequences, and a hosted MCP server plus a Postman collection cover every endpoint. Even so, nothing shows that key UI features such as the visual workflow builder, segment builder, form builder, and site/team administration can be created or managed through the API, so full UI parity is not established. Missing for 10: API/CLI evidence for creating and editing workflows, segments, and forms; an explicit statement of API–UI parity; independent hands-on corroboration.
